OIL AND GAS REGULATORY AUTHORITY
OIL AND GAS REGULATORY
AUTHORITY
SERVICE REGULATIONS, 2005
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part II,
11th July, 2011]
S.R.O.
693(I)/2011, dated 6-7-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred by
subsection (2) of section 14 read with subsection (2)(d) of section 42, of the
Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002 (Ordinance No. XVII of 2002),
the Authority is pleased to make the following amendments in the Oil and Gas
Regulatory Authority Service Regulations, 2005:
In
the aforesaid Regulations:--
(i) In
Regulation 106, the existing sub-regulation will be numbered as (1)
(ii) In
Regulation 106, following sub-regulations will be added:--
(2) In
the event of winding up of the Authority under section 40 of the OGRA
Ordinance, 2002, the regular employees of the Authority, in service on the date
of winding up, shall be paid gross salary equal to their earned leave balance,
to be calculated for every balance number of day, in addition to other terminal
benefits as admissible under these regulations.
(3) Severance
compensation payable will be calculated as on 30th June of each financial year
and any shortfall in the balance of fund will be contributed by OGRA to the
trust.
(4) Leave
salary payable will be calculated as on 30th June of each financial year and
any shortfall in the balance of fund will be contributed by OGRA to the trust.
(5) A
separate trust for this purpose shall be established by the Authority which
shall be called Severance Compensation Fund Trust.
(iii) Amendments
in Revised Criteria of Executives of General Service Group Annexure
"A" of OGRA Service Regulations, 2005
(iv) Revision
of Pay Scales of OGRA Employees in Annexure "B" (to be effective from
January 1, 2011)
